def is_nested(s):
    opens = [i for i, ch in enumerate(s) if ch == '[']
    closes = [i for i, ch in enumerate(s) if ch == ']']
    pairs = 0
    j = len(closes) - 1
    for i in opens:
        if j >= 0 and i < closes[j]:
            pairs += 1
            j -= 1
            if pairs >= 2:
                return True
    return False

# Tests
print(is_nested('[[]]'))            # True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))  # False
print(is_nested('[][]'))            # False
print(is_nested('[]'))              # False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))          # True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))          # False
